name: audit-roadmap-executability-credibility
title: Audit roadmap executability and credibility
description: Audit the current Qiongli 2 master roadmap for executable sequencing, evidence-backed status, internal consistency, and credible next-task readiness without changing roadmap state.
creator: jxpeng98
notes: Read-only audit complete. The roadmap remains useful for strategic sequencing (3/5 executability) but is not a reliable live-state authority (2/5 credibility): it has 233 IDs versus the claimed/Epic-mapped 232, no machine-readable program ledger, stale current/next language, and locally completed EVAL-401 through EVAL-407 that are not integrated into 2.x. The recommended next roadmap task is a bounded GOV-401 through GOV-403 program-ledger foundation; GitHub Project fields remain unverified because read:project is unavailable.
